moments.text: Infrared view looking down on rippled sea. The crosshair starts on a small boat with a bright white wake, then slowly drifts ahead of it.
A small dark dot shows left of the crosshair; the view slides left toward it while the boat moves out past the right edge.
The dark dot wanders around just below the crosshair over bright, rippled sea.
The picture blinks black, grey, white and grainy for about half a second as the sensor changes view.
Zoomed in on flatter grey sea with faint vertical bands; the dark dot is larger, below the crosshair, and slides left.
The dot loops through the lower left of the frame, dips near the bottom edge, then rises to just left of the crosshair as the clip ends.

notes: Official description says 00:00-00:03 no content, but the file shows the boat scene from frame 0.
